fusions.name: Linked Bash
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Plumb Bob
fusions.desc: Hurls a heavy link that deals 28 damage and bursts for 80% of that to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Turned Back
fusions.desc: For 7 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 55% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicts it.

fusions.name: Fixed Position
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
